name: create_knowledge
description: Create a new knowledge file for an identity. Knowledge files are automatically injected into the agent's context when relevant. Use this to give an agent domain expertise, reference materials, or operational guides.

identity_name.description: The identity to add knowledge to (e.g. 'dante', 'coder', 'research_expert')

content.description: The knowledge content (text). Can be documentation, guides, reference materials, rules, etc.

filename.description: Optional filename for the knowledge file. Defaults to '{knowledge_name}.txt'
